messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: `pd-trigger:kv-cache-latency` — 45s p95 > SLO threshold. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked. link: https://pd/reduce-noise

maria: ack'd oncall — looking now. any customer reports?

pagerduty-bot: maria acknowledged the alert (maria) — escalation paused.

ajay: seeing a couple of 503s in the lambda logs for gen-api at the same time window. low volume but spikes align.

lina: checking runtime dashboard (latency by model). curious — a small cluster of Dedicated workers show high tail latency and KV cache miss rate spiking.

sam: can you paste the k/v metrics? I remember a warmup job landed earlier that might cause eviction.

lina: snippets:```
kv-cache.hit_rate: 0.62 -> 0.21
kv-cache.evictions: +430 over 2m
worker_p95_rt: 720ms -> 1800ms
```

maria: hmm, autoscaler did a small scale-in 3m before the spike, then burst of requests likely caused cold starts + KV misses. non-critical but noisy. any API error budget impact?

ajay: error budget small blip — about +0.02% for the minute. no sustained increase.

devops-bot: Running quick probe: `pctl cluster describe redwood-dedicated/us-east-1`

devops-bot: probe output: `nodes: 12 (3 recently started <120s), pod_restart_count: 0, gpu_mem_util: normal`

maria: rolling back the warmup commit? which change was that?

lina: warmup tweak merged 2h ago — should only reduce initial KV size, but looks like it forced evictions across some shards.

sam: temporary mitigation — increasing KV cache size on affected shards and putting autoscaler to conservative for 10m. I'll run the commands now.

sam: `kubectl -n runtime scale deployment kv-cache --replicas=3 && pctl kv set --shard=7 --max_entries=400000`

sam: applied. give it 60s to settle.

ajay: traffic looks like it's decreasing naturally. p95 trending back down to ~350ms.

lina: kv hit rate recovering: 0.21 -> 0.58. good sign.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert `pd-trigger:kv-cache-latency` auto-resolved (condition cleared). :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks team. no manual PD escalation needed. I will silence noisy rule for 15m to avoid repeat pages while we watch.

maria: action items: 1) revert warmup tweak and re-evaluate; 2) add guardrails to prevent global eviction on small config changes; 3) postmortem if we see repeat. tagging @ajay @lina for triage.

ajay: adding short note to #incidents for customers: "Transient internal cache warmup caused brief latency spike; no sustained customer impact."

lina: handing off to night oncall — @sam, you're up for the next 2h?

sam: yep taking handoff. will monitor dashboards and remove temporary kv size change after 30m if stable.

maria: thanks, handing off. closing thread once stable and temp changes reverted. :thumbsup:
